cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of our complaint about the boss calling us furniture. Did that hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I read what you've written?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Access will follow your statement. How did it make you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I went home and cried.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So did I. You're authorized to replace 'inappropriate language' with that. Then bring it back; I approve the final wording.
